quest: Find 25 real user complaints about AI search invisibility on X

1.name: Brand Invisibility to AI
1.insight: Brands discover they're completely invisible to ChatGPT/Perplexity — zero AI-driven discovery despite strong Google rankings.

2.name: SEO → GEO Paradigm Shift
2.insight: Traditional SEO is no longer sufficient; brands need Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to be cited by AI.

3.name: Inconsistent AI Answers
3.insight: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude give conflicting answers about the same brand, revealing fragmented AI knowledge graphs.

4.name: Click/Revenue Loss from AI Overviews
4.insight: AI overviews cut organic clicks 60-70%, making brands that aren't cited invisible to purchase-ready buyers.

5.name: Competitor Advantage in AI Search
5.insight: Competitors appearing in AI answers capture leads while non-optimized brands lose market share silently.
